prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1271; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headache radiating to the base of the skull. Pain was rated 6 out of 10 at initial evaluation. Range of motion of the cervical spine was reduced in rotation and extension, with mild paraspinal muscle tenderness and no focal neurological deficits. Neurological screening, including strength, sensation, and reflexes of the upper extremities, was within normal limits. No radiographic imaging was indicated at this time given the absence of red-flag findings.

Treatment consisted of gentle cervical range-of-motion exercises, application of heat and ice, and a short course of prescribed muscle relaxant and anti-inflammatory medication. The patient was advised to avoid heavy lifting and to use a supportive pillow during sleep.

At the second visit, the patient reported partial improvement, with pain decreased to 4 out of 10 and improved rotation. Soft tissue findings were less pronounced. The patient was counseled on a home stretching program and instructed to return if symptoms worsen or fail to improve. Prognosis for full recovery within several weeks is good, provided the home program is followed consistently.
